newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady on mills' demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady on mills' demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Saturday, bolstered by buying by mill owners in Punjab province. Dealers said the demand could push up prices.

"Cotton demand is strong from Punjab, which has kept rates high in Sindh province," dealer Kishan Chand said. "The arrival of fresh supplies has picked up, but growers are demanding high rates because of the strong demand."
In kerb market, NIAB-78 was traded between 2,150 ($53) to 2,200 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
